title: `topics/the-second-person-evidential-channel` source fidelity — the "dark matter" quotation is a research-note paraphrase promoted to a verbatim quote (abstract says "could — paradoxically — be seen as representing"), the ~200 ms "mode" attributed to Stivers et al. 2009 is not in their abstract (±250 ms spread around the *mean*), hyperscanning and the synchrony-artifact caution carry no citation, and "protoconversation" is credited to Trevarthen when the coinage is Bateson 1975
